title: Anti-vaping Legislation
problem_statement: I need a report on legislation regulating the sale and consumption of electronic cigarettes and their parts and accessories in various countries. The report has to include the dates that laws were passed, the countries, the specific content of the laws, and the legal reasoning behind them. It would also be useful to find information on any measurable outcomes on the effectiveness of these laws, especially with regards to the health of teenagers and young adults.
background: I am a legislative aide to a state senator drafting a vaping-regulation bill for the next session. The senator wants the bill modeled on laws with demonstrated results, not symbolic gestures. I need to know which countries passed what, when, on what legal reasoning, and with what measurable effects on youth vaping. The report will determine which provisions make it into our draft.

title: Advantages of Nordic walking
problem_statement: I need a report that explains what advantages Nordic walking—a modified form of walking that uses specially designed poles—can offer compared to normal walking. The report should explain whether Nordic walking is beneficial and, if so, who is it especially good for.
background: I want to assess whether Nordic walking is a suitable and safe exercise for my elderly parents, including how physically demanding it is compared to regular walking, what health benefits it provides, and any potential risks or limitations, so that I can decide whether to recommend it and how they might start it safely.

title: "Lying Flat" movement in China
problem_statement: I need a report that explains the "lying flat" movement in China, how it came about, why it has become popular among Chinese young people, and Chinese government's attitude towards it.
background: I am a human-resources executive at a multinational with offices in Shanghai and Shenzhen, where managers report rising disengagement among young staff. I keep hearing the phrase 'lying flat' and want to understand the movement's origins, appeal, and the government's response. Our retention strategy for Chinese offices needs cultural context, not stereotypes. The report will brief our regional leadership team.

title: Ketamine Treatments for PTSD
problem_statement: I need information on how ketamine can be used to properly treat PTSD and other mental health disorders. Information that is medically proven, and not illegal is relevant. Any anecdotal stories or proven medical studies are relevant.
background: I work for the VA and am looking at alternative treatments for veterans suffering from PTSD or other trauma that has impacted their mental health. I have heard that ketamine shows promise, but due to its potential for abuse, I want to understand how to properly use this drug and what medical guidance is necessary. I need the information to assist medical practitioners at the VA on how to administer this drug.

title: Felinotherapy as Animal-Assisted Therapy
problem_statement: I need a report about felino therapy as a form of animal-assisted therapy that uses cats to improve the well-being of human patients. The report should explain whether and for whom it is beneficial, including children with behavioral and emotional disorders, hyperactive children, autistic children, and individuals with anxiety disorders.
background: I am a special-education teacher whose classroom serves children with autism and anxiety-related needs. Our school is considering an animal-assisted program, and I have proposed cats as a calmer alternative to therapy dogs. I need the evidence on felino therapy benefits for the populations I teach. The report will support the proposal I bring to the principal and parent committee.

title: Ketamine Treatments for PTSD
problem_statement: I need information on how ketamine can be used to properly treat PTSD and other mental health disorders. Information that is medically proven, and not illegal is relevant. Any anecdotal stories or proven medical studies are relevant.
background: I am a clinical psychologist in private practice treating several patients with treatment-resistant PTSD. Patients increasingly arrive asking about ketamine after reading about it online, and I need to answer responsibly. I want the medically validated evidence on ketamine for PTSD and related disorders, clearly separated from hype and from illegal use. The report will guide whether I build referral relationships with ketamine clinics.

title: Health Effects of Being a Night Owl
problem_statement: Being a morning person is often associated with numerous health benefits. I need a report on the potential negative effects of being a night owl, including how staying up late can impact energy levels throughout the day and whether night owls tend to display lower levels of life satisfaction and overall happiness.
background: I am a night owl who is thinking about healthier lifestyle and considering a change in my chronotype as an option. I would like to share my report with my family members and friends so that those of them who are night owls will think seriously about changing the habit.

title: Montessori Schools
problem_statement: I need information about Montessori schools known for their child-centered approach to education, emphasizing hands-on learning, student agency, and individualized instruction. The report should include the information on how children of different ages learn together, fostering collaboration and social development, and if this approach benefits them in the future.
background: I am a preschool teacher deciding whether to invest in Montessori certification, which costs a year of evenings and considerable tuition. Before committing, I want evidence on whether the method's mixed-age, child-led approach delivers lasting benefits. Outcomes research matters more to me than philosophy. The report will determine whether I enroll in the training program.

title: Nuclear Power Plants During Conflict
problem_statement: I need a report on the danger nuclear power plants pose during conflict, such as war or terrorist attack. The report should include specific incidents of nuclear power plants being captured by invading troops/ terrorists/ rebels etc. (e.g., Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant in Ukraine during the Russian invasion). The report should also cover the potential danger of such incidents, such as interruptions in power supply, logistical difficulties, and radioactive leak/ meltdown threat. Information on how such incidents have been resolved is important for the report.
background: I am the emergency-management planner for a county that hosts a nuclear power station. Recent seizures of plants in conflict zones have prompted my board to ask whether our contingency plans cover deliberate attack, not just accidents. I need the documented incidents, the risks they revealed, and how they were resolved. The report will inform the revision of our emergency response annex.

title: Effects of X-ray and CT Radiation on the Body
problem_statement: I am looking for a report that examines the harmful effects of radiation exposure from X-rays to CT scans on the human body. Specifically, does this radiation cause cancer or alter DNA? The report should reference studies conducted by the International Agency for Research on Cancer and the National Toxicology Program.
background: As a health science student, I want to understand the potential harmful effects of radiation exposure from medical imaging procedures like X-rays and CT scans, so I can evaluate whether they increase cancer risk, alter DNA, and what levels of exposure are considered safe in clinical practice.

title: Snack nutrition around the world
problem_statement: I need a report about what people eat for snacks  between meals in countries around the world. In the U.S., foods eaten between meals are often are often not as nutritious as foods eaten for meals.  Helpful information includes what types of foods children and/or adults eat between meals, whether these foods are considered nutritious, and how each society looks at snacking.Attitudes about snacks may be found in advertisements as well as in professional papers and on visual media.  information about what makes people choose a particular snack is also helpful
background: I am a student preparing to attend culinary school  for a year in Italy, and then a year in Thailand.  I would like to learn about similarities and differences in various countries' snacking cultures  (food eaten between main meals) and about the nutrition density of snacks in different countries, and also the context for snacking in various places.

title: National Elections and AI-generated political content
problem_statement: I need a report that analyzes how the use of artificial intelligence, including deepfakes and AI-generated political content, may influence voter behavior and public trust during national elections.
background: I am a researcher focused on election security and information integrity. I need a report that examines how AI-generated content, including deepfakes, may influence voter decision-making and public trust during national elections. The findings will support my assessment of emerging risks to democratic processes and political stability.

title: Anti-vaping Legislation
problem_statement: I need a report on legislation regulating the sale and consumption of electronic cigarettes and their parts and accessories in various countries. The report has to include the dates that laws were passed, the countries, the specific content of the laws, and the legal reasoning behind them. It would also be useful to find information on any measurable outcomes on the effectiveness of these laws, especially with regards to the health of teenagers and young adults.
background: I am an activist campaigning for stricter regulations on electronic cigarettes in my state. I want to understand what specific laws and regulations work best, especially in protecting the health of teenagers and young adults.

title: Effects of X-ray and CT Radiation on the Body
problem_statement: I am looking for a report that examines the harmful effects of radiation exposure from X-rays to CT scans on the human body. Specifically, does this radiation cause cancer or alter DNA? The report should reference studies conducted by the International Agency for Research on Cancer and the National Toxicology Program.
background: I am the parent of a child with a chronic condition that has required repeated CT scans since infancy. Each scan order makes me anxious, and I want to understand the real risks rather than internet speculation. I need what the major research bodies have found about radiation from X-rays and CT scans, including cancer and DNA effects. The report will help me have an informed conversation with our specialist.

title: Protecting the Endangered African Penguin
problem_statement: I need a report that talks about the measures taken to protect the African penguin. The report should include the population changes of the species over the years and the major factors that have led to the decline of the species. The report should include authoritative estimations or opinions pertaining to the possible extinction of the species. The report also needs to include information about the measures of South Africa and the international communities to protect the endangered species.
background: I manage the conservation grants program at a large metropolitan zoo that partners with African field projects. Our board is considering a multi-year commitment to African penguin recovery and wants evidence before approving funds. I need the population trends, the drivers of decline, expert assessments of extinction risk, and what South African and international programs are already doing. The report will determine the size and focus of our grant.

title: Chip H200
problem_statement: I need a report on how NVIDIA CEO is shaping the company’s strategy during the rapid growth of artificial intelligence technologies. The report should describe the role of NVIDIA’s H200 chip in the AI market, key partnerships and customers that support the company’s growth, and how NVIDIA is responding to increasing global demand for AI computing resources. The report should also discuss how the company balances technological innovation, client demand, and export-control regulations, as well as how NVIDIA’s strategy is viewed in important markets such as Taiwan and other regions involved in the semiconductor industry.
background: I lead infrastructure procurement for a fast-growing cloud startup whose roadmap depends on securing AI accelerators. NVIDIA's H200 allocation decisions and Jensen Huang's strategic moves directly affect my delivery timelines and pricing. I need to understand how the company is balancing demand, innovation, and export controls. The report will inform how I structure our next hardware contracts.

title: Benefits of Board Games for Children
problem_statement: I need a report on how playing board games as a child affects the ability to learn. The report should explore the cognitive, emotional, and academic benefits including its impact on memory, attention, language development, and overall academic performance.
background: I am a mother who is trying to understand the benefits of having my child learn to play board games. I want to know how board games might help with my child’s cognitive development, academic success, and overall learning abilities, but I am unsure if it is truly worth the time and effort.

title: Economic Impact of the 2021 Haiti Earthquake
problem_statement: I need a report on the economic impact of the August 2021 earthquake in Haiti. Being one of the strongest earthquakes in recent Haitian history, it caused unspeakable damage. Information such as numbers of houses lost, cost of infrastructure damage, businesses impact are relevant.
background: I am an analyst with the World Bank. I need to know how much aid the WB needs to provide and in what arenas. I need to know how best to provide what Haiti needs, as well as avoid potential abuse of the funds provided.

title: Traveling circuses over the past 100 years
problem_statement: I need a report telling me how the perception and realities of traveling circuses have changed in various countries in the past 100 years. Useful information includes how popular circuses were and currently are, what are considered appropriate show acts and sideshow acts now as opposed to then, and where circuses still exist.  Other Information such as availability of a traveling circus to  various parts of a country's population, cost to attend, physical setup of the circus, what it contains, and how circuses advertise, and are viewed by the residents in a country,  as well as other information that explains  their popularity or lack thereof, is helpful.
background: I am a novelist drafting a book set in a traveling circus that moves across several countries between the 1920s and today. I need to know how circuses actually operated and changed: their acts, their economics, their advertising, and how towns received them. Authentic period detail will make or break the manuscript. The report will serve as my primary research file.

title: Russian-Venezuelan Strategic Relations
problem_statement: I need a report that describes the strategic relationship between Russia and Venezuela. Information on their military, diplomatic, or economic collaboration is relevant, especially if there are any effects on third-party countries or third-party country involvement. Information on how such collaboration might negatively affect other countries is of particular importance.
background: I am a staffer for a congressional foreign-affairs subcommittee preparing my member for hearings on Western Hemisphere security. I need a current picture of Russian-Venezuelan military and economic cooperation, including any involvement of third countries. The hearing briefing book is due in three weeks. This report will be the foundation of the memo I draft.

title: Increased Popularity of the Camino de Santiago
problem_statement: I need a report that explains the dramatic increase in the number of pilgrims from across the world who have been called to walk the ancient pilgrimage in northern Spain known as the Camino de Santiago.  The report should include the growth in U.S. pilgrims (historically among the least represented), the motivations behind the increase, and its impact on the route's infrastructure and the regional economy.
background: I am a hospitality entrepreneur evaluating whether to open a small albergue on the Camino Francés. Before I sign a lease, I need to understand the surge in pilgrims, especially the growth in American walkers, and whether the route's infrastructure is keeping up. Seasonal patterns and regional economic data will tell me if the business can survive the winter months. This report is the core of my feasibility study.

title: Digital India Act
problem_statement: I need a report on Digital India Act. My report should include information about the background and purpose of the legislation, a brief summary of the main provisions, its significance to the economic development of India, and how it has been implemented since passage.
background: I am a market-entry consultant advising technology companies on expansion into India. Clients keep asking how the Digital India Act affects data practices, compliance costs, and market opportunity. I need the law's background, main provisions, economic significance, and how implementation has actually unfolded. The report will inform the regulatory briefings I sell to clients.

title: Loneliness Epidemic
problem_statement: I need a report that explains why loneliness has become a growing psychological and public health concern around the world. The report should examine how changes in technology, social media, remote work, family structures, and modern social relationships have contributed to increasing feelings of isolation despite greater digital connectivity. It should also analyze the effects of loneliness on mental and physical health and explore what governments, healthcare organizations, and communities are doing to address this issue.
background: I volunteer with a nonprofit organization that works to reduce social isolation in the community. We have seen increasing concerns about loneliness among people of different ages and would like to better understand the causes of this trend. I need information on the factors contributing to loneliness so that we can develop programs that help people build stronger social connections.

title: The Joyce Hatto Scam
problem_statement: I need a report on the extent to which our perception of art is influenced by what we believe about the artist rather than by the art itself. I am particularly interested in the case of Joyce Hatto, one of the most remarkable frauds in classical music history. Hundreds of recordings were released under her name, many of which were later discovered to have been copied from performances by other pianists.
background: I am an amateur musician and classical music enthusiast who once admired Joyce Hatto as a pianist and collected many of her CDs, only to discover that the recordings were not her own. I find it fascinating that technological tools can both facilitate and expose deception. I am also curious as to why so many critics genuinely admired the recordings before the fraud was uncovered.

title: What do kids most like to read for fun?
problem_statement: I need a report telling what children (under 18 years of age) prefer to read for fun.  Fiction, or nonfiction, what focus, genres, formats?  How much does their reading preference change as they grow?  How much do television, toys, movies and music affect their choices?  And will different countries show notably different answers and in what ways?
background: I am an acquisitions editor at a children's publisher planning our list two years out. I need current evidence on what children actually read for pleasure: genres, formats, how preferences shift with age, and how screen media shapes their choices. Differences across countries matter because we sell translation rights. The report will inform which manuscripts I champion at our acquisitions meetings.

title: Buyers of Poached African Wildlife
problem_statement: I need a report on the buyers of poached African wild animals. The report should include information about who the buyers are and how they connect with illegal hunters and complete the sales. Information released from conservation groups, government agencies like police departments, individual activists, etc., is all relevant.
background: I design training curricula for customs and border officers in East Africa. To teach interdiction effectively, my trainees need to understand the demand side: who buys poached wildlife, how buyers connect with hunters, and how sales are completed. Material from conservation groups, police, and activists all helps. The report will become a core module in next year's training program.

title: Long Covid
problem_statement: I need a report on Long Covid, its impact on patients, and resources available to them. The report should include how medical professionals define Long Covid, what the symptoms of Long Covid are, and what body systems can be affected. The report should also discuss the medications and therapies available to Long Covid patients, as well as other resources, such as Long Covid clinics, clinical trials, and disability support services.
background: I work for a community healthcare provider and we provide services to patients who suffer Long Covid. I would like to find out more information about Long Covid, including the most recently research on the causes, symptoms and medications and therapies, so as to have a better idea about prospects for Long Covid treatment.

title: Making Better Drugs In Space
problem_statement: I need a report that explains how microgravity environments or "weightlessness" helps to design better drugs for diseases like cancer and Alzheimer's. It should highlight why space is the "ultimate laboratory" for precision medicine. The report should also include recent commercial initiatives in this area if any, and the potential advantages and challenges of manufacturing pharmaceuticals in space.
background: I manage the research portfolio at a mid-sized pharmaceutical company deciding whether to fund a microgravity crystallization experiment. Competitors are sending work to orbital stations, and my board wants to know if this is science or theater. I need to understand why weightlessness helps drug design and what commercial ventures have actually achieved. The report will determine whether we budget for a space-based pilot.

title: E-Waste Management Challenges
problem_statement: I need a report that describes how electronic waste is affecting the environment, public health, and international recycling industries. The report should include disposal practices, informal recycling sectors, environmental pollution, government regulations, and efforts to improve sustainable waste management systems. I am interested in how different countries address growing volumes of electronic waste.
background: As an environmental compliance analyst, I need to understand global e-waste management challenges so that I can evaluate sustainable recycling policies and environmental risks.

title: Benefits of Fermented Foods
problem_statement: I need a report that outlines the positive health effects of fermented foods. This report should include how fermented foods improve digestive issues, reduce inflammation, improve skin conditions, as well as improve mental health issues. Also, the report may include how fermented foods have a longer shelf life, and provide unique flavor profiles.
background: As someone struggling with digestive issues, I was recommended by my doctor to learn how fermented foods can help reduce various intestinal and digestive problems. I want to learn how fermented foods help reduce inflammation and restore the flora in the intestinal tract, and how it reflects holistically on other aspects of health.

title: How does donating clothing affect the environment?
problem_statement: I need a report on the net environmental and economic effects of donating or discarding unwanted textiles (clothing, linens, etc...)  How are the discarded/donated materials distributed/recycled/destroyed, and what are the costs involved?  Are there deleterious effects of textiles winding up in a landfill or being destroyed?
background: I manage operations for a charity thrift chain that receives far more donated clothing than we can sell. I need to know what actually happens downstream: how surplus textiles are distributed, recycled, exported, or destroyed, and at what cost. Donors increasingly ask whether giving us clothes is better than throwing them away, and I want an honest answer. The report will shape both our logistics and our public messaging.

title: Arthritis treatments: PT vs Chiropractor
problem_statement: I want a report about physical therapy versus chiropractic therapy as treatments for mobility and pain. The report should focus on the differences between chiropractic therapy and physical therapy for treating arthritis.
background: I am a primary-care physician whose arthritis patients regularly ask whether to see a physical therapist or a chiropractor. I want a clear comparison of the two approaches for arthritis pain and mobility so my referrals rest on evidence rather than habit. Outcomes data and safety considerations matter most. The report will standardize the guidance I give in clinic.

title: Gluten Intolerance Growth
problem_statement: I am looking for information about recent trends in gluten intolerance. What are the statistical trends in gluten intolerance, and how are people interpreting those trends? The report should include what currently understood about how prevalent gluten intolerance is, whether and why gluten intolerance is becoming more common, how wider awareness has impacted diagnostic practices, and how people develop gluten intolerance.
background: I own a neighborhood bakery and keep losing customers who say they have gone gluten-free. Before investing in a dedicated gluten-free line, I want to know whether gluten intolerance is genuinely rising or mostly a dietary trend. The statistics, the diagnostic changes, and the science of how intolerance develops all matter to my decision. The report will decide whether I retool half my kitchen.

title: The Dopamine Loop
problem_statement: This article should explore the hidden architecture of the "infinite scroll" and what specifically makes our brains stay active longer than intended. It should break down the core issue from a biological perspective to show why stopping feels physically difficult. It will also examine why our prehistoric brains are ill-equipped for modern digital devices that act like "slot machines." Finally, it provides practical strategies to help the reader break the cycle and move toward more intentional phone usage.
background: I am a manager leading a team of fifteen, yet I find myself losing hours to my phone screen without meaning to. I see my colleagues doing the same during breaks, and I want to understand why our brains can't seem to just 'put it down' even when we have deadlines looming.

title: Thrifting / Second-Hand Clothes
problem_statement: I need a report that explains why second-hand clothing has become popular again. The report should also examine how major fashion brands have responded by launching resale and sustainability initiatives, and identify the most popular online platforms used for buying and selling second-hand clothing. In addition, I need information on which clothing brands are currently in high demand in the second-hand market.
background: I am planning to open a second-hand clothing store. I would like to understand whether this type of business is likely to be profitable, and what factors influence success in the resale fashion market.

title: E-Waste Management Challenges
problem_statement: I need a report that describes how electronic waste is affecting the environment, public health, and international recycling industries. The report should include disposal practices, informal recycling sectors, environmental pollution, government regulations, and efforts to improve sustainable waste management systems. I am interested in how different countries address growing volumes of electronic waste.
background: I coordinate recycling programs for a county that just lost its electronics-waste contractor. Before we issue a new contract, I want to understand where e-waste actually ends up, the risks of informal processing, and which regulatory models work. Residents are asking hard questions about whether our program is genuinely safe. The report will shape the standards we write into the new contract.

title: Fires Aboard Car-Carrier Ships
problem_statement: I need a report that provides information and analysis on fires that occurred on cargo ships transporting cars at sea. The report should include: the dates of the fires, information about the ships and the vehicles onboard, damages to the ships and the vehicles, findings or conclusions from any investigations for each accident, and notable speculation if no official conclusion is available. Fires started from electric cars are particularly of interest. Please pay special attention to incidents where electric vehicles were identified as the source or suspected source of the fire.
background: I am the safety officer for a shipping line that carries vehicles on roll-on/roll-off vessels. Recent car-carrier fires, especially those linked to electric vehicles, have my management demanding updated procedures. I need the incident history: dates, ships, cargo, damages, and investigation findings. The report will drive the revised stowage and firefighting protocols I must deliver.

title: Semiconductor Industry in Brazil
problem_statement: I need a report that describes Brazil’s semiconductor industry. The report should include the history and current status of the industry in the country as well as the key focus of the industry in terms of the categories. The report should also include information on the core competitiveness of the industry in Brazil and the challenges it faces.
background: I am a trade-policy analyst at a Latin American development bank assessing where semiconductor investment in the region could succeed. Brazil is the obvious candidate, and I need its industry's history, current focus, competitive strengths, and structural challenges. Member governments want realistic guidance, not boosterism. The report will feed the regional industrial-strategy review I am drafting.

title: Militarization of Space Concerns
problem_statement: I need a report that describes the concerns of various countries regarding the militarization of space. The report should include information on possible increase in space-based weaponry, its potential for eroding diplomacy and increasing conflict. What are the challenges in monitoring potential military activities in space?
background: I am a journalist who focuses on international relations as they pertain to global security. Space is emerging as a new arena for conflict. I would like information that would help create a framework for cooperation between countries that are peers in space technology and concerned about this potential new threat.

title: Online Romantic Scams
problem_statement: I need a report on contemporary online romantic scams. The report should include the technologies fraudsters use to contact and attract their potential victims, and the psychological manipulation tactics they employ to drag money out of them. I want the report to cover some specific cases of romantic scams in various countries and include statistics. It is also of interest what groups of people are potentially most vulnerable to romantic scammers, and how people can protect themselves from this type of fraud.
background: I am a concerned daughter. My 60-year-old widowed mother is very sweet, naive, and not very good with technology. Lately she has been talking a lot about “a very nice elderly gentleman from Germany” she met on social media with whom they “have a lot in common”. She is completely infatuated with him. The red flag for me is that it all has happened very quickly, and lately Mom has been talking a lot of her online boyfriend experiencing major health issues and needing some costly medical treatments. I want to have a serious talk with my mother, and I want to come armed with reliable information on online romantic scams.

title: Benefits and drawbacks of overseas study
problem_statement: I need a report explaining the benefits and drawbacks of studying overseas. Useful information includes personal growth, knowledge, cost, possible dangers, or any other outcomes from studying abroad. Input on these topics from all sources is useful.
background: I am the parent of a high-school junior who is pushing hard to spend a university year abroad. The price tag worries me, and so do safety and whether the benefits are real or romanticized. I need a balanced account of the personal, academic, and financial outcomes of overseas study. The report will help our family make this decision with open eyes.

title: Denmark and Wind Power
problem_statement: I want a report detailing Denmark’s wind energy industry. How did it develop? Who are the major players? What percentage of Denmark’s energy needs are now provided by wind power?
background: I work in a state energy office drafting an offshore wind roadmap for our governor. Denmark is the model everyone cites, and I need to know whether its experience transfers: how the industry developed, who the major players are, and what share of Danish demand wind now meets. Honest numbers matter more than promotional ones. The report will anchor the international benchmarking chapter of our roadmap.

title: Downshifting by Choice
problem_statement: I need a report about downshifting as the practice of intentionally reducing one's lifestyle, work responsibilities, or consumption to improve overall well-being and achieve a better work-life balance. The report should explain how transitioning to a less demanding job, reducing work hours, simplifying consumption habits, or prioritizing leisure and relationships can benefit a person.
background: I am a career coach whose clients increasingly arrive burned out and asking permission to step back rather than up. To advise them responsibly, I need a solid account of downshifting: reduced hours, simpler consumption, and the wellbeing outcomes of each path. I also want to know where downshifting goes wrong. The report will shape the framework I use in client sessions and workshops.

title: The Joyce Hatto Scam
problem_statement: I need a report on the extent to which our perception of art is influenced by what we believe about the artist rather than by the art itself. I am particularly interested in the case of Joyce Hatto, one of the most remarkable frauds in classical music history. Hundreds of recordings were released under her name, many of which were later discovered to have been copied from performances by other pianists.
background: I am a cognitive psychology researcher studying how expectations shape aesthetic judgment, preparing a case-study lecture for my graduate seminar. The Joyce Hatto fraud is the perfect natural experiment: critics praised recordings under her name that they had ignored under the original artists'. I need the full timeline of the scam and the critical reception before and after exposure. The report will anchor both my lecture and a planned journal article.

title: AI for natural disaster prediction
problem_statement: I want a report on how artificial intelligence is helping predict natural disasters like earthquakes or hurricanes. The report should include specific examples, types of models being used, and whether these technologies are becoming more accurate.
background: I'm a volunteer with an international disaster relief nonprofit. I don't have a tech background but need to write a briefing on recent trends for my team to consider adding AI alerts to our emergency planning protocols.

title: Britney Spears' Conservatorship Case
problem_statement: I need a report on the famous singer Britney Spears ending her 13-year long conservatorship in court in 2021. The report should include the reasons and the terms for her conservatorship, the history of her legal struggle to end it, and Britney's life and success post-conservatorship. I want the report to also cover the impact the case has had for society in terms of financial abuse awareness, mental health struggles, and women's exploitation in the entertainment industry.
background: I am an elder-law and guardianship attorney who lectures continuing-legal-education courses on conservatorship reform. The Britney Spears case changed how my field discusses financial abuse and autonomy, and attendees always ask about it. I need the legal history: the original terms, the thirteen-year fight, and the aftermath. The report will let me teach the case accurately rather than from headlines.

title: Sherry wine and "tapas"
problem_statement: I need a report on the history, origins, type of grapes used, and existing varieties of Sherries, as well as their food pairings.
background: I am the beverage director for a restaurant group opening a Spanish concept next spring. Sherry will anchor the wine list, and my staff needs to sell it confidently to guests who think it is just a cooking wine. I need the history, grape varieties, styles, and classic tapas pairings. The report will become our staff training manual and shape the opening list.

title: Generational shift away from alcohol
problem_statement: I need a report on how the beverage industry is adapting to younger generations drinking less alcohol, including the growth of non-alcoholic products and other alternatives, the demographics driving the shift, and relevant sales data.
background: I own three cocktail bars in a college town and have watched alcohol sales slide each year as younger customers order differently. I am considering dedicating a third of my menu to sophisticated non-alcoholic drinks. I need to understand what alternatives younger consumers actually want and how other venues have adapted. The report will guide my menu redesign and supplier contracts.

title: Health Benefits of Propolis
problem_statement: I need a report that describes the health benefit attributed to propolis, a resinous substance collected by bees. The report should give specific information about its benefit to human body as a food supplement or in topical medications. Any individual cases showing results of taking or using propolis will be relevant. Information that mentions clinical statistics or trials will be preferred.
background: I am the owner of a small food supplement store. We plan to import and sell propolis. I need to have more information about the health benefit of the product to prepare some promotional materials. I hope to find information about real health benefit of the product to include in our product introduction/stories.

title: Long Covid
problem_statement: I need a report on Long Covid, its impact on patients, and resources available to them. The report should include how medical professionals define Long Covid, what the symptoms of Long Covid are, and what body systems can be affected. The report should also discuss the medications and therapies available to Long Covid patients, as well as other resources, such as Long Covid clinics, clinical trials, and disability support services.
background: I manage disability accommodations for a large employer and have seen a steady rise in Long Covid cases among staff. To handle requests fairly, I need to understand how clinicians define the condition, its symptoms and affected body systems, and the treatments and support resources available. Accommodation decisions must rest on medical reality. The report will shape our HR guidance and return-to-work plans.

title: Making Better Drugs In Space
problem_statement: I need a report that explains how microgravity environments or "weightlessness" helps to design better drugs for diseases like cancer and Alzheimer's. It should highlight why space is the "ultimate laboratory" for precision medicine. The report should also include recent commercial initiatives in this area if any, and the potential advantages and challenges of manufacturing pharmaceuticals in space.
background: As a reader with no background in biology or pharmaceutical science, I am curious when I read the headline news that major pharmaceutical companies are increasingly sending research to space stations to conduct drug-related experiments using microgravity environment. I would like to understand why microgravity matters.

title: India's Population Surpasses China's
problem_statement: I need a report on the global implications of India surpassing China as the world's most populous country, comparing the two countries' demographics and analyzing how their differing age structures may affect the economy, innovation, and labor markets.
background: I lead global market strategy for a consumer-goods company built around Chinese manufacturing and sales. India overtaking China in population forces a rethink of where our growth and production should go. I need demographic comparisons and projections of how each country's age structure affects labor, innovation, and consumption. The report will frame our next five-year market plan.

title: Denmark and Wind Power
problem_statement: I want a report detailing Denmark’s wind energy industry. How did it develop? Who are the major players? What percentage of Denmark’s energy needs are now provided by wind power?
background: I'm preparing a presentation on sustainable energy and want to include Denmark as a model in wind energy. Denmark is well known as "the country of windmills" and I want to learn how its wind industry developed, who’s behind it, and whether it really powers much of the country.

title: Pokemon popularity in children of adult fans
problem_statement: I need a report on the popularity of Pokemon among today's children, with emphasis on the children of adult fans. Are children whose parents are Pokemon fans more likely to be interested, or does Pokemon appeal to children on its own through current marketing and legacy? What keeps the adult fans engaged? Useful data includes the share of children and adults interested today, which features appeal to which age groups, and the current cost and value of cards and merchandise.
background: I am a teacher of elementary and middle -school kids and see many of then interested in Pokemon.  Some of them say that their parents are fans, and I am interested in knowing if most of the children today are coming into the Pokemon world due to their parents' interest, or if the current Pokemon advertising and legacy are interesting to kids without parental influence.  This information will help us to decide if a Pokemon theme will be interesting for a school-wide activity,

title: Gluten Intolerance Growth
problem_statement: I am looking for information about recent trends in gluten intolerance. What are the statistical trends in gluten intolerance, and how are people interpreting those trends? The report should include what currently understood about how prevalent gluten intolerance is, whether and why gluten intolerance is becoming more common, how wider awareness has impacted diagnostic practices, and how people develop gluten intolerance.
background: I'm a mom who is concerned about her child suddenly feeling ill after eating wheat/gluten when there has not been any prior issues. I'm looking for information on the causes of such an intolerance and how it might impact my family. I'm also looking for ways to prevent my child from feeling unwell.

title: Earthquake Forecast
problem_statement: I need a report on the advancement of earthquake forecast technologies. I am interested in finding out if substantial progress has been made in the area and the cases of successful forecast in recent years if any. In particular, I would like to find information about any new methods of earthquake forecasting that may increase the accuracy of forecasting and make longer term forecasting.
background: I am a catastrophe-risk modeler at a reinsurance company that prices earthquake coverage across the Pacific Rim. Any real advance in forecasting would change how we model losses and set premiums. I need a sober assessment of recent progress and any verified forecasting successes, separated from hype. The report will feed directly into next year's model review.

title: Princess Catherine's Popularity
problem_statement: I need a report on Catherine, the Princess of Wales, and the secrets of her popularity with the British public. The report should include the princess's ratings in public opinion polls compared to those of other members of the royal family, the perception of Catherine's performance of her royal duties, her views on child rearing, her battle with cancer, and her personal and fashion style. The report should analyze how Catherine, being a commoner, after a period of some initial distrust in the British media, has gained respect and popularity in the UK and all over the world, and has humanized and modernized the supposedly obsolete institution of the British monarchy.
background: I am a middle school student, and I have an assignment to make a presentation on a contemporary woman whom I respect and admire. I have chosen Catherine because I have always liked her fashion style and her elegant manners. I want to learn more about the secrets to her popularity, and the subtle ways she is transforming the British monarchy.

title: Crocs Fashion Phenomenon
problem_statement: I need a report about the phenomenon of Crocs, often described as the transformation of an object widely considered unattractive into a global fashion and cultural success. I am particularly interested in the "ugly-cool" effect—that is, how Crocs became a symbol of a broader fashion trend in which unconventional, awkward, or deliberately "ugly" items gained appeal—and, more generally, why wearing something that ignores traditional beauty standards can itself become a statement.
background: I am a fashionista who has always preferred beauty and style over comfort. Seeing more and more influencers wearing Crocs, I am puzzled by how they found their way into so many wardrobes.

title: Marriage Rate Decline
problem_statement: I need a report that examines why marriage rates are declining and why many people are choosing to marry later in life compared to previous generations. The report should explore economic pressures, career priorities, changing gender roles, and shifting attitudes toward long-term relationships.
background: I am a priest who provides premarital counseling and I would like to better understand why marriage rates are declining around the world so that I can address these concerns in my counseling and help young people consider marriage more thoughtfully.

title: The Importance of Early Water Competency and Swimming Proficiency in Children
problem_statement: This report aims to elucidate the multifaceted importance of swimming for children. It will examine swimming primarily as a critical safety measure for drowning prevention, while also exploring its value as a form of physical exercise and a source of broader developmental and psychological benefits. The scope includes the efficacy and importance of introducing water safety and swimming skills to infants, toddlers, and school-aged children.
background: I am the aquatics director for a city parks department lobbying to expand subsidized swim lessons for children. The budget office wants evidence, not sentiment. I need the research on drowning prevention, the developmental and psychological benefits of early water competency, and the best ages to start instruction. The report will be the core of my budget proposal.

title: Princess Catherine's Popularity
problem_statement: I need a report on Catherine, the Princess of Wales, and the secrets of her popularity with the British public. The report should include the princess's ratings in public opinion polls compared to those of other members of the royal family, the perception of Catherine's performance of her royal duties, her views on child rearing, her battle with cancer, and her personal and fashion style. The report should analyze how Catherine, being a commoner, after a period of some initial distrust in the British media, has gained respect and popularity in the UK and all over the world, and has humanized and modernized the supposedly obsolete institution of the British monarchy.
background: I am a reputation consultant who advises public figures recovering from media hostility. Princess Catherine's arc from tabloid skepticism to broad public trust is the case study my clients ask about most. I need her polling compared with other royals, and how her duties, parenting, health disclosure, and style shaped perception. The report will become a module in my client workshops.

title: Risks of monosodium glutamate
problem_statement: I need a report that explains how MSG (monosodium glutamate), a widely used flavor enhancer that contains glutamate found naturally in many whole foods such as tomatoes, mushrooms, and Parmesan cheese, affects our health. The report should address the potential health risks of MSG, including reactions sometimes referred to as “MSG symptom complex”.
background: I am a registered dietitian who counsels clients on sodium reduction, and several have asked nervously whether MSG is safe. I want a clear account of the evidence behind 'MSG symptom complex' and how it compares with MSGs benefit of lowering sodium needs. I need to give advice grounded in research rather than folklore. The report will inform the patient handout I am writing.

title: Astronaut Oleg Kononenko
problem_statement: I need a report on Russian cosmonaut Oleg Kononenko, who has spent a record 1,111 cumulative days in space across multiple missions. The report should describe the specific missions of his stay in space, the challenges he had, and information about his health and mental conditions after he returned to Earth.
background: I am an editor from a popular science magazine in Japan and I am writing an article about astronauts who spend a very long time in space. Oleg Kononenko has a record of 1111 days in space, and I am going to cover the story as the main part of the article.

title: Climate Change and Species Extinction
problem_statement: I need a report describing how climate change contributes to the extinction of various species of plants and animals, and the impact of this on the ecosystem. What is being done to decrease the threat of extinction for affected species?
background: I direct education programs at a botanical garden that hosts thirty thousand school children a year. We are building a new exhibit on climate change and species loss, and the content must be scientifically sound. I need to understand how warming drives extinctions, what that does to ecosystems, and what interventions are underway. The report will be the factual foundation for the exhibit panels and teacher guides.

title: Young Voters Gender Divide
problem_statement: I need a report on how voting choices among young voters (ages 18-29) have been influenced by gender in various countries. The report has to include information on whether young women indeed tend to lean more liberal and left-wing, and young men more conservative, and should cover statistics for this demographic group for various elections in various countries in recent years. It is also of interest what specific issues young men and women mostly disagree on, and what are the economic, political, and social roots of the supposed gender divide in voting choices.
background: I am a college professor teaching a Comparative Cultural Analysis class, and one of the topics on my syllabus is elections and voting choices. Traditionally, my class covers Russia and the US, but this year I want to include some European, Latin American, and Asian countries in my analysis. My students are generally young (18-22), diverse, and very politically engaged, so I am hoping this angle on the topic will inspire and motivate them in their learning.

title: China's dominance in green energy
problem_statement: I need a report on how China became a global leader in renewable energy and its impact on climate change. The report should include China's dominance in different green energy markets and how it's viewed by other countries, especially the US. It should also discuss the challenges China faces, both domestically and internationally.
background: As an environmental activist, I want to understand whether China's use of clean energy has made any impact on climate change and to what extent its policies and practices are applicable to other countries. I am also interested in learning more about the challenges presented to other countries by China's overcapacity in solar, wind, batteries and EV.

title: TikTok and Sustained Attention
problem_statement: I need a report that evaluates the claim that constant exposure to the brief, highly stimulating content characteristic of Tik Tok short, rapidly changing videos may make it harder for young people to maintain focus on longer tasks such as reading books, studying, or attending lectures. In particular, I am interested in research examining the possibility that frequent switching between pieces of content may encourage a habit of seeking constant novelty rather than developing the capacity for sustained concentration.
background: I am an English literature teacher who believes that the complex themes and ideas explored in classic works often require time, context, and careful explanation. I am concerned that TikTok’s short-video format may encourage oversimplification and that young people are becoming accustomed to receiving information in quick, easily digestible fragments rather than developing the patience and intellectual discipline needed to explore subjects in depth.

title: Britney Spears' Conservatorship Case
problem_statement: I need a report on the famous singer Britney Spears ending her 13-year long conservatorship in court in 2021. The report should include the reasons and the terms for her conservatorship, the history of her legal struggle to end it, and Britney's life and success post-conservatorship. I want the report to also cover the impact the case has had for society in terms of financial abuse awareness, mental health struggles, and women's exploitation in the entertainment industry.
background: I am a podcaster who runs a show on women in the entertainment industry with a feminist angle. I am researching for an episode on Britney Spears' journey to personal and financial independence. I want to educate my listeners on their legal and financial rights, and to warn them of potential abuse dangers.

title: The Rise of Cyber Attacks
problem_statement: I need a report that analyzes the rise of cyberattacks targeting critical infrastructure, specifically banking systems and healthcare networks. The report should examine common attack methods such as ransomware, phishing, and supply chain vulnerabilities, and explain what risks these attacks pose to financial stability, public safety, and national security, as well as how governments and organizations are responding to strengthen cybersecurity defenses.
background: I work as a policy analyst in a government security advisory team and need a report on the rise of cyberattacks targeting banking and healthcare systems. The purpose is to understand common attack methods and assess the risks they pose to financial stability, public safety, and national security in order to inform cybersecurity policy and response planning.

title: Himalayan Glacier Changes
problem_statement: I need a report that describes how melting glaciers in the Himalayan region are affecting water supplies, agriculture, hydropower, and local communities. The report should include climate trends, regional scientific research, environmental risks, and cooperation between neighboring countries that rely on glacier-fed rivers. I am interested in both current environmental impacts and long-term resource challenges.
background: I am a documentary filmmaker developing a feature on water security in South Asia. The melting of Himalayan glaciers is the through-line of the film, and I need a rigorous factual base before scouting locations. I want the climate trends, the science, and the cross-border politics of glacier-fed rivers. This report will anchor the script and tell me whom to interview.

title: How AI Affects Endangered Languages
problem_statement: With an indigenous language vanishing every two weeks, this report investigates how artificial intelligence is being urgently deployed to document, translate, and revitalize regional dialects. It explores the benefits of automated transcription and Large Language Models alongside critical technical limitations like data scarcity. Ultimately, it evaluates how local communities and linguists are utilizing these innovative digital tools to safeguard their unique cultural heritage before it disappears.
background: I direct education programs for a tribal council whose heritage language has fewer than two hundred fluent speakers, most of them elderly. We have grant money to digitize recordings and are weighing AI transcription and language-model tools. I need to know what these tools can and cannot do with scarce data, and how other communities have used them. The report will determine how we spend the grant.

title: Fertilizer Supply Disruptions
problem_statement: I need a report that describes how disruptions in global fertilizer supplies are affecting agricultural production and food prices in different regions. The report should include the causes of supply shortages, trade restrictions, energy costs, and the impact on farmers and crop yields. I am interested in how governments and agricultural industries are responding to long-term fertilizer instability.
background: I am an agricultural credit officer at a rural bank that finances planting seasons for hundreds of family farms. Fertilizer price spikes now threaten my borrowers' margins and our loan book. I need to understand the causes of supply disruption, how long instability may last, and what responses are emerging. The report will recalibrate the risk models behind our lending.

title: Loneliness Epidemic
problem_statement: I need a report that explains why loneliness has become a growing psychological and public health concern around the world. The report should examine how changes in technology, social media, remote work, family structures, and modern social relationships have contributed to increasing feelings of isolation despite greater digital connectivity. It should also analyze the effects of loneliness on mental and physical health and explore what governments, healthcare organizations, and communities are doing to address this issue.
background: I am the dean of student life at a residential university where counseling visits for isolation have doubled since the pandemic. Before we redesign housing, advising, and campus programming, I need to understand the drivers of the loneliness epidemic and which interventions actually help. Health consequences and institutional responses both matter to my case. The report will inform the student wellbeing strategy I owe the provost.

title: AI for natural disaster prediction
problem_statement: I want a report on how artificial intelligence is helping predict natural disasters like earthquakes or hurricanes. The report should include specific examples, types of models being used, and whether these technologies are becoming more accurate.
background: I am the emergency management director for a county exposed to both hurricanes and flash floods. Vendors are pitching AI-based early-warning systems, and I need to separate proven capability from marketing. I want concrete examples of AI disaster prediction, the model types involved, and the accuracy trend lines. The report will guide whether I spend grant money on these systems.

title: Risks of monosodium glutamate
problem_statement: I need a report that explains how MSG (monosodium glutamate), a widely used flavor enhancer that contains glutamate found naturally in many whole foods such as tomatoes, mushrooms, and Parmesan cheese, affects our health. The report should address the potential health risks of MSG, including reactions sometimes referred to as “MSG symptom complex”.
background: One important benefit of MSG is its ability to enhance flavor while reducing the need for excess salt. As a foodie and health-conscious individual, I am looking for new ways to vary my low-sodium diet without giving up the taste and quality of the food I enjoy.

title: K-drama vs C-drama
problem_statement: I need a report that analyzes the reasons for the global popularity of Korean dramas and Chinese dramas on American streaming platforms. It should outline the key factors behind K-drama and C-drama's global popularity and appeal. The report should present the reasons whether and why K-drama is more popular than C-drama.
background: I host a podcast on TV shows for film enthusiasts, and currently I am researching an episode on Asian dramas. I want to educate my viewers on the differences in pacing, acting, subject matter, production, artistic styles, and cultural values behind Chinese and Korean dramas. I want my audience to have a more informed viewing experience while enjoying these shows.

title: K-drama vs C-drama
problem_statement: I need a report that analyzes the reasons for the global popularity of Korean dramas and Chinese dramas on American streaming platforms. It should outline the key factors behind K-drama and C-drama's global popularity and appeal. The report should present the reasons whether and why K-drama is more popular than C-drama.
background: I love TV dramas and I am trying to decide whether I should watch K-drama or C-drama, both are dominating global streaming. I want to know the background for this cultural phenomenon, why some people prefer K-drama while others prefer C-drama, and what kind of viewing experience they offer.

title: Male ballet dancers
problem_statement: I need a report that explains why men in the performing arts have historically faced assumptions or mockery tied to rigid ideas about masculinity. The report should examine why, in many cultures, young girls are encouraged to take ballet, while boys are often looked down upon for pursuing a career as ballet dancers.
background: I am the father of a nine-year-old boy who asked for ballet lessons after seeing a touring production of The Nutcracker. My own family is openly skeptical, and I worry about how classmates will treat him. I want to understand where the stigma against male dancers comes from and how other families and dancers have handled it. The report will help me support my son with confidence rather than worry.

title: Condominium Board Opposition to EV Charger Installations
problem_statement: I need a report that sheds light on why many condominium boards are opposed to the installation of electric vehicle (EV) chargers. I am particularly interested in understanding the concerns they may have regarding costs, risks, administrative challenges, as well as potential legal and governance issues.
background: I am an electric vehicle (EV) owner who recently purchased a condominium unit and applied to install an EV charger at my deeded parking space. The board members, however, chose a cautious approach, and I am trying to understand the reasons behind their decision.

title: Graffiti: Art, Vandalism, and Public Tolerance
problem_statement: I need a report about graffiti as a widely recognized art form that is celebrated for its creativity, technical skill, and cultural impact, while also often being applied illegally to public or private property without permission. The report should examine how governments, communities, artists, and property owners view graffiti, and how different cities balance its artistic value against concerns about vandalism and property rights. I am particularly interested in whether the artistic and cultural value of illegal graffiti influences public tolerance and policy responses toward it.
background: I direct the public works department for a mid-sized city that spends heavily on graffiti removal every year. The arts council is pressuring us to designate legal walls instead of erasing everything. I want a balanced view of graffiti's artistic standing and how other cities draw the line between art and vandalism. This will inform the policy recommendation I owe the mayor next quarter.

title: Homeschooling Around the World
problem_statement: I need a report that provides information on homeschooling in primary and secondary education. The report needs to include information about relevant laws and regulations of any countries, particularly with regard to curriculum requirements for applying for higher education and test mechanisms.
background: I am an expatriate parent moving my family between countries every few years for work, and conventional schooling has become disruptive for my children. I am weighing homeschooling but worry about university admission requirements. I need to know how different countries regulate homeschooling, what curricula are accepted, and how testing works. This report will determine whether we commit to homeschooling for the next posting.

title: Smart city development
problem_statement: I need a report that explains how cities around the world are implementing smart city technologies to improve transportation, public services, energy efficiency, and urban management. The report should include digital infrastructure projects, privacy concerns, sustainability goals, government investment, and differences in implementation across regions. I am interested in how technology is transforming urban development and public administration.
background: I am chief of staff to the mayor of a city about to spend a bond issue on digital infrastructure. Vendors promise everything, and I need an independent view of what smart-city technologies have actually delivered elsewhere. Privacy backlash worries me as much as wasted money. The report will help us write requirements that avoid other cities' mistakes.

title: Marriage Rate Decline
problem_statement: I need a report that examines why marriage rates are declining and why many people are choosing to marry later in life compared to previous generations. The report should explore economic pressures, career priorities, changing gender roles, and shifting attitudes toward long-term relationships.
background: I am a market analyst for a national wedding-industry trade group whose members are anxious about shrinking bookings. I need to understand why marriage rates are falling and why couples marry later, separating economic causes from cultural ones. Our members want to know whether demand is delayed or disappearing. My annual industry outlook depends on this analysis.

title: Benefits of Board Games for Children
problem_statement: I need a report on how playing board games as a child affects the ability to learn. The report should explore the cognitive, emotional, and academic benefits including its impact on memory, attention, language development, and overall academic performance.
background: I coordinate after-school programming for a network of elementary schools and have a modest budget to expand enrichment activities. A board-game club is cheap and popular, but the district wants educational justification. I need the research on how board games affect memory, attention, language, and academic performance. The report will support the proposal I submit to the district office.

title: Ethnic minorities access to education worldwide
problem_statement: I need a report that describes the access to education of different ethnic minorities and how it has impacted the preservation of their language and traditions. How does it contribute to their financial success as a community, and the preservation of their culture in a globalize society?
background: I am a program officer at an international education NGO designing grants for minority-language schooling. I need evidence on how education access affects minority communities' economic outcomes and their ability to keep languages and traditions alive. Donors want proof that culturally grounded schooling works. The report will shape our next funding round.

title: Homeschooling Around the World
problem_statement: I need a report that provides information on homeschooling in primary and secondary education. The report needs to include information about relevant laws and regulations of any countries, particularly with regard to curriculum requirements for applying for higher education and test mechanisms.
background: I am a blogger in China and I recently got a lot of questions about homeschooling practices around the world. So I will write an article to address the topic by introducing various practices and relevant laws and regulations, viewpoints of educators as well as the future trend of homeschooling.

title: Thrifting / Second-Hand Clothes
problem_statement: I need a report that explains why second-hand clothing has become popular again. The report should also examine how major fashion brands have responded by launching resale and sustainability initiatives, and identify the most popular online platforms used for buying and selling second-hand clothing. In addition, I need information on which clothing brands are currently in high demand in the second-hand market.
background: I am the sustainability officer at a mid-market apparel brand whose executives are debating a branded resale program. I need to understand why second-hand clothing surged, which resale platforms dominate, and how competitors' take-back initiatives have performed. I also want to know which brands hold their value on the resale market. My recommendation to the leadership team depends on this analysis.

title: Intermittent Fasting
problem_statement: I need information about Intermittent fasting as any of various meal timing schedules that cycle between voluntary fasting (or reduced calorie intake) and non-fasting over a given period. The report should include the information on whether it can reduce the risk of diet-related diseases, such as metabolic syndrome, as well as hypertension. The report should also include potential risks involved in intermittent fasting.
background: I am a nurse practitioner in an endocrinology clinic where patients with metabolic syndrome constantly ask about intermittent fasting. I need a balanced account of the evidence: whether timed eating reduces risks like hypertension and metabolic disease, and what dangers it carries for which patients. Fads move faster than guidelines, and my advice has to keep up. The report will inform the counseling protocol I draft for our clinic.

title: Generational shift away from alcohol
problem_statement: I need a report on how the beverage industry is adapting to younger generations drinking less alcohol, including the growth of non-alcoholic products and other alternatives, the demographics driving the shift, and relevant sales data.
background: I work for Budweiser developing new products. I have been noticing a decline in sales of traditional products. I need to learn more about alternatives to alcoholic beverages.

title: Benefits of Fermented Foods
problem_statement: I need a report that outlines the positive health effects of fermented foods. This report should include how fermented foods improve digestive issues, reduce inflammation, improve skin conditions, as well as improve mental health issues. Also, the report may include how fermented foods have a longer shelf life, and provide unique flavor profiles.
background: I am launching a small-batch fermented foods company and need more than enthusiasm to win shelf space and investors. Buyers keep asking which health claims I can legitimately make about kimchi, kefir, and kombucha. I need the evidence on digestion, inflammation, skin, and mental health, plus the shelf-life advantages. The report will shape both my packaging claims and my investor pitch.

title: TSMC in Japan
problem_statement: I need a report on the business expansion of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) in Japan. The report should provide information about TSMC's investment made or to be made in Japan, its partnerships with Japanese companies and the job opportunities created in Japan.
background: I work in economic development for a Japanese prefecture competing to attract semiconductor suppliers. TSMC's expansion is reshaping where chip-industry jobs and investment land in Japan. I need details on its investments, Japanese partnerships, and hiring so I can position our region for the supply chain growing around the fabs. My next investor prospectus depends on this picture.

title: The Black Cat Stigma
problem_statement: I need a report about the reasons behind people's negative attitudes toward black cats. I would like the report to focus on historical superstition, cultural symbolism, and misunderstanding rather than on practical factors, such as black cats being harder to photograph and therefore less noticeable in adoption listings.
background: I am a volunteer at a local animal shelter, and I have noticed that black cats are abandoned more often than other felines and are sometimes overlooked for adoption compared with lighter-colored cats. I would like to learn more about why people have historically treated black cats negatively and whether these attitudes are rooted in superstition and folklore or in their portrayal in literature, art, and popular culture.

title: Snack nutrition around the world
problem_statement: I need a report about what people eat for snacks  between meals in countries around the world. In the U.S., foods eaten between meals are often are often not as nutritious as foods eaten for meals.  Helpful information includes what types of foods children and/or adults eat between meals, whether these foods are considered nutritious, and how each society looks at snacking.Attitudes about snacks may be found in advertisements as well as in professional papers and on visual media.  information about what makes people choose a particular snack is also helpful
background: I am the nutrition services director for a large school district rethinking what we offer in vending machines and after-school snack programs. Our current options reflect typical American snacking habits, which are not a flattering benchmark. I want to know what children and adults snack on in other countries, how nutritious those foods are, and how different societies think about snacking. Understanding what drives snack choices will help us design options students actually pick up. The report will guide the menu standards I propose to the school board.

title: The Dopamine Loop
problem_statement: This article should explore the hidden architecture of the "infinite scroll" and what specifically makes our brains stay active longer than intended. It should break down the core issue from a biological perspective to show why stopping feels physically difficult. It will also examine why our prehistoric brains are ill-equipped for modern digital devices that act like "slot machines." Finally, it provides practical strategies to help the reader break the cycle and move toward more intentional phone usage.
background: I am a high-school guidance counselor who sees students arriving exhausted after scrolling until two in the morning. I am building a digital-wellness workshop and need to explain the brain science of the infinite scroll in terms teenagers will accept. I also want practical, evidence-based strategies they can try. The report will give my workshop its scientific backbone.

title: Increased Popularity of the Camino de Santiago
problem_statement: I need a report that explains the dramatic increase in the number of pilgrims from across the world who have been called to walk the ancient pilgrimage in northern Spain known as the Camino de Santiago.  The report should include the growth in U.S. pilgrims (historically among the least represented), the motivations behind the increase, and its impact on the route's infrastructure and the regional economy.
background: I am a U.S. citizen who first encountered the Camino de Santiago while living in northern Spain as a teenager in the 1970s. I want to understand how and why pilgrim numbers have changed so dramatically since then.

title: Child-free families: Patterns Across Regions
problem_statement: I would like a report about the patterns and reasons behind the growing number of couples who choose not to have children in different regions of the world. Please describe the cultural, economic, and policy factors shaping the family decisions.
background: I am a policy analyst at a national pension agency modeling long-term contribution and payout scenarios. The rise of child-free couples changes our demographic assumptions in ways the old models miss. I need to understand the regional patterns and the cultural, economic, and policy drivers behind them. The report will recalibrate the fertility assumptions in our actuarial projections.

title: Astronaut Oleg Kononenko
problem_statement: I need a report on Russian cosmonaut Oleg Kononenko, who has spent a record 1,111 cumulative days in space across multiple missions. The report should describe the specific missions of his stay in space, the challenges he had, and information about his health and mental conditions after he returned to Earth.
background: I am an aerospace medicine researcher studying the limits of human endurance in orbit. Oleg Kononenko's 1,111 cumulative days in space make him an essential case study for long-duration mission planning. I need details of his missions, the challenges he faced, and his physical and psychological condition after return. The report will inform a review article on crew health for Mars-length missions.

title: Optometry versus Ophthalmology as a career choice
problem_statement: I need a report comparing optometry and ophthalmology from the perspective of career development. I am interested in finding out pros about career in optometry in terms of job stability, salaries, work/life balance, and the outlook of the profession. I am also interested in finding out the merits of private vs. corporate practice and the training requirements in optometry. The same information about ophthalmology is also important for the purpose of comparison.
background: I am a second-year college student who is very strong in the sciences and have always been interested in vision and matters concerning the eyes.  My parents want me to go to medical school and become an ophthalmologist, but I don't want to spend that many years in school and then (probably) in debt.  When I mention optometry, my parents express their dismay and worry about my future income and job prospects.  I need to convince them that optometry is a valid career choice and I won't have to move back home after my education. I am flexible and willing to relocate.
