title: Professional Athletes in the Fashion Industry
problem_statement: I need a report that explains how professional athletes have become influential figures in the fashion industry and how their partnerships with luxury and streetwear brands have changed global fashion trends. The report should examine why athletes are increasingly viewed as fashion icons and how social media has contributed to their influence on consumer culture.
background: I am a sports agent negotiating endorsement deals for two clients who want fashion partnerships rather than traditional sneaker contracts. I need to understand how athletes become credible luxury and streetwear figures and what role social media plays in that influence. Knowing which collaborations succeeded will strengthen my position at the negotiating table. The report will shape the pitch decks I send to brands.

title: Chip H200
problem_statement: I need a report on how NVIDIA CEO is shaping the company’s strategy during the rapid growth of artificial intelligence technologies. The report should describe the role of NVIDIA’s H200 chip in the AI market, key partnerships and customers that support the company’s growth, and how NVIDIA is responding to increasing global demand for AI computing resources. The report should also discuss how the company balances technological innovation, client demand, and export-control regulations, as well as how NVIDIA’s strategy is viewed in important markets such as Taiwan and other regions involved in the semiconductor industry.
background: As a long-term tech investor and active trader monitoring NVIDIA (NVDA), I want to better understand how their CEO is shaping the company’s growth through H200 chip deployments and partnerships. I'm especially interested in how Taiwan's market and media view his leadership, product announcements, and client relationships, as this can offer insights into future stock performance and supply chain positioning.

title: Militarization of Space Concerns
problem_statement: I need a report that describes the concerns of various countries regarding the militarization of space. The report should include information on possible increase in space-based weaponry, its potential for eroding diplomacy and increasing conflict. What are the challenges in monitoring potential military activities in space?
background: I am a research fellow at an arms-control think tank drafting a policy brief on orbital security. Member governments are asking how seriously to take space weaponization and what verification is even possible. I need the range of national concerns, the monitoring challenges, and the diplomatic stakes. The report will feed recommendations we present at a multilateral forum.

title: Felinotherapy as Animal-Assisted Therapy
problem_statement: I need a report about felino therapy as a form of animal-assisted therapy that uses cats to improve the well-being of human patients. The report should explain whether and for whom it is beneficial, including children with behavioral and emotional disorders, hyperactive children, autistic children, and individuals with anxiety disorders.
background: I am a caregiver looking for non-conventional ways to improve my patients’ well being and am considering felino therapy as an AAT (Animal Assisted Therapy). I want to learn more about felinotherapy, especially which patients might benefit the most from felino therapy and what benefits have been attributed to felino therapy.

title: NVIDIA (NVDA): Growth Drivers and Investment Risks
problem_statement: I need a report that explains why NVIDIA (NVDA) has become one of the fastest-growing technology companies and why many investors are interested in its stock. The report should examine how the company’s role in artificial intelligence (AI), gaming technology, and computer chips has contributed to its rapid growth, while also analyzing how the stock has performed over time and the potential benefits and risks of investing in NVDA.
background: I am a fee-only financial advisor with several retired clients asking whether it is too late to buy NVIDIA stock. I need a clear account of what has driven the company's growth, how the stock has behaved over time, and the genuine risks at current valuations. My clients depend on income from their portfolios and cannot absorb large losses. The report will support the guidance I give in their annual reviews.
